column1: # Required operational cutover gates. Status is `open` or `complete`; the third field records the missing proof or completed evidence.

column3: Rehearse verified online backup, failed-start rollback, and one-flag Python restoration on a production-shaped snapshot.
Add startup health, Discord/DB write smoke, failure detection, and automatic rollback checks for the Rust runtime image.
Implement Rust-owned clean/existing database migrations, then complete every repository adapter and A/B delta test on old and current schema snapshots with Python stopped.
Make cama-rust serve the live gateway as sole runtime and prove command schemas, interaction timing, visibility, mentions, components, attachments, and errors with Python stopped.
Replay recorded OpenDota, Dotabase, Steam asset, and LLM provider success/failure/fallback contracts without live CI network.
Implement production renderers and pass semantic, pixel/perceptual, font, animation, and attachment-retry comparisons.
Provide health metrics, structured logs, deploy metadata, alerting, and a post-deploy verification checklist.
Register persistent views and prove buttons, modals, pagination, restart recovery, stale callbacks, and reconnect behavior.
Replay representative reads and writes on independent sanitized copies of a current production-shaped database and compare deltas.
Prove every transition schema and Rust write remains readable by the retained Python artifact after cutover.
Replace the Compose bot process with cama-rust behind the existing service, UID, volume, environment, GIT_SHA, and SSH deploy path; no Python process may be required after cutover.
Wire all periodic workers with startup recovery, cancellation, retry, idempotency, and graceful shutdown parity.
Both images acquire /app/data/.cama-runtime.lock before DB or gateway startup; bidirectional fs2/flock tests and CI/local container overlap smoke reject the second runtime and prove no DB is created.
Replace remaining in-memory application stores with existing-schema SQLite adapters and transactional interoperability tests.
